title: 001 血月中元002 寻找月光
content_zh:
：漆黑的洞窟，伸手不见五指。
管明晦在僵硬的躯体中恢复意识。
他记得自己刚才还在公司大楼里加班，当时正逢七月半，又恰好遇上月食。
窗外的月亮一点点变得残缺，并染上一层越来越浓的血色。
时至深夜，窗外灯光越熄越少。
管明晦像往常一样点了夜宵，却被告知找不到骑手，无法配送。
“这破班老子实在是上够了！
每个月才给几千窝囊费，天天加班，天天加班！
部门主管也是个贱畜，看老子好说话，专门压榨老子。
还有这狗屁鬼节，外卖员都跑回家躲着了，点份夜宵都没人送。
这世上哪有鬼？有鬼先出来，给我啃两口，看老子不把你们撅巴撅巴当夜宵吃了！”
他骂骂咧咧，暴躁地发泄在身体内酝酿已久的怨气。
连骂了十几分钟，胸口还是堵得慌。
怨气不但没有减少，反而沸腾起来，一股股的直往脑袋里冲，带来阵阵眩晕。
他以为自己又犯困，冲了两袋速溶咖啡，几口灌进肚子里，反引得胃里泛酸，胸腹间更加燥热，不过总算精神了些。
坐回电脑前继续工作，才敲了几下键盘，他突然感觉眼前发黑，伴随着天旋地转，身体向前倾倒。
来不及有任何作为，记忆便就此断片……
等再次了有了意识，已经到了这个充满黑暗的洞窟之中。
身体僵硬冰冷，仿佛生铁铸成，没有正常的知觉。
洞窟内没有半点光亮，他却能清晰地地感知到周围的石壁和身下的石床。

就他妈的跟做梦一样！
难道我已经死了？这里是太平间的冰柜吗？
活人看着是冰柜，鬼魂看着是洞窟？空间重叠？
念头没转完，意识中突然间多了一团记忆：
一个长着两条长长寿眉的中年人，掐诀驾驭七口仙剑攻击自己。
剑光之中闪现出金龙、青蛇、白兔、玄龟等影像。
光气闪耀，势不可挡，将自己的飞剑法宝接连绞碎。
最终七剑合璧，刺穿了自己的胸膛！
这段记忆他还没有来得及理解，又一团记忆涌进来。
他自己操纵九九八十一面神幡，满空飞腾。
每面神幡都被一团亩许大的黑气裹着，里面有飞禽走兽各类兽魂，嘶吼咆哮，张牙舞爪，将两个道人困在里面。
顷刻间将其炼化，连人带法宝化作缕缕血气，元神被收到神幡之上。
记忆一段一段地融合进来，有得意的，有失意的，有杀人的，也有被杀的，有的完整，有的支离破碎，时间上也乱七八糟，前后颠倒。
等把所有记忆全部融合，再把时间人物都捋顺了，管明晦终于弄清楚一个事实：这里是蜀山剑侠传的世界，他成了里面鼎鼎大名的妖尸谷辰！
谷辰，蜀山世界里的玄阴教教主，曾经跟青城派鼻祖李静虚，还有大荒二老约架的狠人，纵横千年，鲜有败绩。
最终在师父天淫教主遭了天诛以后，自己也被峨嵋派掌门长眉真人七剑诛心杀死。
他当时受伤太重，肉身被七修剑刺穿，彻底断绝了生机，元神也被斩成无数碎块。
长眉真人飞升在即，来不及把他收进两仪微尘阵中，用百日之功彻底炼化，就把他镇压在这莽苍山灵玉崖的山腹之内，并留下预言：
content_en:
: A pitch-black cave where you can’t see your fingers.
Guan Minghui regained consciousness in his stiff body.
He remembered that he had been working overtime in the company building just now. It was the middle of July and coincided with the lunar eclipse.
The moon outside the window became crippled little by little, and became increasingly darker in blood.
As it gets late at night, the lights outside the windows become increasingly dim.
Guan Minghui ordered a midnight snack as usual, but was told that the rider could not be found and the delivery could not be made.
"I've had enough of this bad class!
I'm only given a few thousand in stipend every month, and I work overtime every day, every day!
The department head is also a bitch, he just wants to exploit me because I am easy to talk to.
And during this bullshit ghost festival, the delivery people all ran home to hide, and no one even delivered the midnight snacks they ordered.
Where are the ghosts in this world? If a ghost comes out first, give me a few bites to see if I don’t treat you as a midnight snack! "
He cursed and irritably vented the resentment that had been brewing in his body for a long time.
After scolding for more than ten minutes, my chest was still clogged.
Instead of diminishing, the resentment boiled up, rushing straight into his head, causing waves of dizziness.
He thought he was sleepy again, so he brewed two bags of instant coffee and poured it into his stomach in several sips. It caused acidity in his stomach and made his chest and abdomen even hotter, but he finally felt more energetic.
He sat back in front of the computer and continued working. After typing on the keyboard a few times, he suddenly felt his eyes going black, and with the world spinning, his body fell forward.
There is no time to do anything, and the memory is just fragmented...
When he regained consciousness again, he was already in this cave full of darkness.
His body was stiff and cold, as if made of pig iron, and he had no normal consciousness.
There was no light in the cave, but he could clearly feel the surrounding stone walls and the stone bed beneath him.
It's just like a fucking dream!
Am I already dead? Is this the morgue's freezer?
Living people see it as a freezer, and ghosts see it as a cave? Space overlap?
Before the thought was finished, a group of memories suddenly appeared in his consciousness:
A middle-aged man with two long eyebrows used a secret technique to control seven swords to attack him.
The golden dragon, green snake, white rabbit, black turtle and other images flashed in the sword light.
The aura shimmered and was unstoppable, crushing his flying sword magic weapon into pieces one after another.
In the end, the seven swords combined and pierced his chest!
Before he had time to understand this memory, another memory came flooding in.
He controlled ninety-nine and eighty-one sacred flags, flying in the sky.
Each of the sacred flags was wrapped in a cloud of black air as large as an inch. There were various beast souls of birds and animals inside, roaring and roaring, baring their teeth and claws, trapping the two Taoists inside.
It was refined in an instant, and the person and magic weapon were transformed into wisps of blood, and the soul was received on the divine flag.
Memories are integrated piece by piece, some are triumphant, some are frustrated, some are murderous, some are killed, some are complete, some are fragmented, and the time is also messy, reversed.
After all the memories were integrated and the time and characters were smoothed out, Guan Minghui finally figured out one fact: This is the world of Shushan Swordsman Legend, and he became the famous demon corpse Gu Chen in it!
Gu Chen, the leader of the Xuanyin Sect in the world of Shushan, once fought with Li Jingxu, the founder of the Qingcheng Sect, and the two elders of Dahuang for thousands of years without ever losing.
In the end, after his master, Tianyin Cult Master, suffered a slaying from Heaven, he was also killed by the Seven Swords of the Seven Swords of the Emei Sect's leader, Chang Mei Zhenren.
He was too seriously injured at the time, his body was pierced by the Seventh Cultivation Sword, his vitality was completely cut off, and his soul was chopped into countless pieces.
Changmei Zhenren was about to ascend. He had no time to take him into the Liangyi Dust Formation and use a hundred days of work to completely refine him, so he suppressed him in the belly of the Lingyu Cliff of Mangcang Mountain, and left a prophecy:
